evidence: Matches kernel files (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h) and introduces a new kernel C API and C++ wrapper.
rationale: Adds API endpoints to libbitcoinkernel allowing external applications to validate blocks without maintaining a complete chainstate database. This meaningfully expands library capabilities for lightweight indexers and custom applications.
